At 140 kg green beans/year (1.0 ha), moving from $5.78/kg to $8.25/kg adds approximately $346.50/season.

RECOMMENDED STEPS

Selective picking: Harvest only fully red (ripe) cherries. Reject green and overripe. Can improve grade by 1–2 levels.
Same-day processing: Process cherries within 6–12 hours of picking to avoid fermentation defects.
Flotation sorting: Float cherries in water — defective, hollow beans float and can be removed cheaply.
Extended fermentation control: For washed: ferment 36–48 hours at altitude. Over-fermentation (sour notes) is the #1 defect cause.
Raised bed drying: Dry on African raised beds (not ground), turn frequently. Target moisture: 10.5–11.5%.
Proper storage: Store parchment in grain bags at <12% RH. Re-mill within 3 months of harvest for best cup quality.
COUNTRY-SPECIFIC NOTE — ETHIOPIA
In Ethiopia, most defects are black beans (over-fermented), insect-damaged, and withered. Key: selective picking + fermentation control.
